couplets.en: If we part this time, perhaps one day we will meet in dreams.

lines: Ab ke hum bichhde to shayad kabhi khwabon mein milein
Jis tarah sookhe hue phool kitabon mein milein
couplets.en: If we part this time, perhaps we will meet in dreams, the way dried flowers turn up in books.

lines: Dhoond ujade hue logon mein wafa ke moti
Ye khazane tujhe mumkin hai kharabon mein milein
couplets.en: Seek pearls of fidelity among the dispossessed, for you may find such treasures in ruins.

lines: Tu Khuda hai na mera ishq farishton jaisa
couplets.en: You are no god, and my love is no angel's love.

lines: Dono insaan hain to kyun itne hijabon mein milein
couplets.en: We are both human, so why meet behind so many veils?

lines: Nasha badhta hai sharabein jo sharabon mein milein

lines: Ab na wo main, na wo tu hai, na wo maazi hai, Faraz
couplets.en: Faraz, neither of us is who we were, and that past is gone.
